answer: Each agent identity is registered in atlas, a Merkle state tree, and must present a zero-knowledge attestation of a TPM/SGX enclave executing the prescribed model; grove, the consensus contract, verifies the proof and raven, a VDF-backed hash anchor, orders registrations. Forging identities requires distinct certified hardware and sequential VDF work; bonds follow an O(N^2) curve, while equivocation causes irreversible collateral slashing.
